description: The reaping number is attained by a reaping family and is at most the size of every reaping family.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.reapingNumber_spec :
  (∃ F,
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.IsReapingFamily F ∧
        Cardinal.mk ↑F = Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.reapingNumber) ∧
    ∀ (F : Set (Set ℕ)),
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.IsReapingFamily F →
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.reapingNumber ≤ Cardinal.mk ↑F
